Atlas CRM Migration — Status Report

Report #4 of 9 · Period: Aug 25, 2026 to Sep 24, 2026

Issued
Sep 24, 2026
Author
J. Okafor, Project Manager —
j.okafor@example.com
Sponsor
M. Alvarez, VP Sales Operations
Distribution
Sponsor, PMO, Delivery team, Vendor engagement lead
Classification
Internal
  1. Executive summary
  2. Status dashboard
  3. Milestones & timeline
  4. Progress this period
  5. Next period
  6. Risks & issues
  7. Decisions needed
  8. Budget & resources
  9. Change log
  10. Appendix

1. Executive Summary

The project is amber: build progress is healthy and the cutover date holds, but data quality findings in the legacy Accounts domain now threaten the UAT start date. Budget is amber on contractor overrun, which we expect to partially recover in October. We need two decisions from the sponsor this period: the cutover freeze window and legacy archive retention.

2. Status Dashboard

  • Overall

    AMBER

  • Schedule

    GREEN

  • Scope

    GREEN

  • Budget

    AMBER

  • Risk

    AMBER

  • Quality

    GREEN

Budget: contractor integration work ran 8% over plan while waiting on vendor API credentials; recovery expected by mid-October. Risk: legacy Accounts data quality (R1) is the driver — see register. All other dimensions are trending as planned.

3. Milestones & Timeline

Milestone status vs. baseline plan
MilestoneBaselineForecast/ActualStatusComplete
Discovery completeSep 5Sep 4DONE100%
Data model freezeSep 20Sep 19DONE100%
UAT startOct 5Oct 9AT RISK70%
Cutover to productionNov 14Nov 14ON TRACK25%
Hypercare endDec 12Dec 12ON TRACK0%

4. Progress This Period

  • Data model frozen after sign-off from sales ops and finance (Sep 19).
  • Migration scripts completed for 3 of 4 domains — Contacts, Leads, Activities; Accounts blocked by R1.
  • 42 of 60 committed user stories done (70%); integration stubs for the 4 vendor APIs verified in the dev environment.
  • Training material first draft delivered; pilot session scheduled with the field team for Oct 1.

Plan vs. actual: 8 of 9 planned items delivered. Accounts migration scripts slipped because profiling surfaced a 12% duplicate-record rate in the source system (see R1); remediation design is underway.

5. Next Period

  • Accounts data cleansing sprint — dedupe rules applied, target <2% duplicate rate (Oct 2).
  • UAT environment build and smoke test (Oct 6).
  • Security review with IT risk (Oct 8).
  • Cutover dry run #1 in staging (Oct 16).

6. Risks & Issues

Top risks and issues (severity × likelihood; owner accountable for mitigation)
IDDescriptionSeverityLikelihoodOwnerMitigation / next actionReview by
R1Legacy Accounts data quality: 12% duplicate rate and 4% records with invalid owners would corrupt migrated pipelines and dashboards.HIGHLikelyP. Sharma (Data lead)Cleansing sprint Oct; freeze new source edits during remediation.Oct 2
R2Vendor API rate limits may extend full-load migration beyond the cutover window.MEDPossibleD. Kim (Integration)Batch-load throttling tested in dry run #1; vendor engaged on quota raise.Oct 16
R3Single-person dependency on legacy CRM workflow logic (S. Nguyen).MEDPossibleJ. Okafor (PM)Knowledge-transfer sessions booked; documentation of 10 critical workflows in progress.Oct 23
I1UAT environment provisioning was blocked 3 days by a network policy change.CLOSED—IT OperationsResolved Sep 18; environment build now scheduled Oct 6.—

Changes since last report: R1 raised (new), I1 closed, R2 severity raised from low after dry-run scheduling confirmed a single-load window.

7. Decisions Needed

Asks of the sponsor — indecision past the required-by date has a cost
DecisionContext / optionsImpact of delay
Approve production freeze window Nov 13–Nov 17Option A: full freeze (recommended, lowest cutover risk). Option B: read-only for sales, higher defect risk during reconciliation.Cutover rehearsal planning stalls; field comms can't be scheduled.Oct 9
Legacy CRM archive retention periodOption A: 24 months (recommended by compliance). Option B: 12 months, cheaper storage, slower recall.Archive vendor contract can't be countersigned; cutover checklist item stays open.Oct 16

8. Budget & Resources

Spend vs. plan (currency: USD thousands)
MeasurePlanActual/ForecastVarianceNote
Spend to date410438+28 (+6.8%)Contractor overrun during vendor credential delay (I-series, closed).
Forecast at completion1,2501,282+32 (+2.6%)Partial recovery from October demobilization of integration contractors.

Resources: data cleansing contractor (1 FTE) onboarding Oct 1 to support R1 remediation. No other staffing changes; no open hiring gaps.

9. Scope & Change Log

Change requests this period
CR IDSummaryStatusSchedule impactCost impact
CR-7Partner portal to receive migrated opportunity historySubmittedTBCTBC
CR-6Field-mapping additions for EMEA tax codesApprovedNone (absorbed)+6

Appendix

Glossary

UAT
User Acceptance Testing — business users validate the system against real scenarios before cutover.
Cutover
The controlled switch from the legacy CRM to the new platform.
Hypercare
Elevated-support period immediately after go-live.
CR
Change Request — a formally assessed change to agreed scope.
RAG
Red/Amber/Green health rating convention.

References

  • Baseline project plan (PMO portal)
  • Full risk register

Internal use only — do not distribute outside the distribution list · Prepared by J. Okafor · Questions: j.okafor@example.com
